summary: Iteration 19 testing complete. Category filtering bug on Ultimate Search Page has been FIXED. The backend endpoint in server.py was missing the category_ids (comma-separated) and aggregation parameters - I fixed this by updating the /api/ultimate-search endpoint. All features now working: category checkbox selection, filter status indicator, AND/OR/AND_OR aggregation logic, map legend with category colors, collate button count, and clear selection button.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 fixed the category filtering bug. The issue was that the /api/ultimate-search endpoint in server.py did not support the category_ids (comma-separated) and aggregation parameters that the frontend was sending. The fix in routes/search.py was not being used because the search router was never included. I updated server.py directly to add the filtering logic. All features verified: 1) Category checkboxes select/deselect, 2) Filter status shows 'Filtering by X categories (AND/OR)', 3) AND/OR/AND_OR radio buttons work, 4) Map legend shows selected categories, 5) Collate button shows count, 6) Clear Selection works, 7) Results are filtered (200 total -> 94 with 2 categories selected).
